entries.zh: 几天之内，那道浅划伤开始长皮愈合。

entries.en: A brown stain showed the river's high-water mark.
entries.zh: 一道棕色污痕显示了河流的最高水位线。

entries.en: The falling snow was a special effect created on the studio floor.
entries.zh: 飘落的雪是在摄影棚里制作的特殊效果。

entries.en: She accepted the invitation like a shot.
entries.zh: 她立刻接受了邀请。

entries.en: Someone shouted out when the lights suddenly failed.
entries.zh: 灯突然熄灭时，有人叫出了声。

entries.en: We served cucumber raita alongside the spicy lentils.
entries.zh: 我们在辣扁豆旁配上了黄瓜酸奶沙拉。

entries.en: The rehearsal ended with a disharmonious clash of instruments.
entries.zh: 排练以一阵不和谐的乐器杂音结束。

entries.en: Our game plan changed when the supplier withdrew.
entries.zh: 供应商退出后，我们的行动计划改变了。

entries.en: The novel follows a reformed thief who falls from grace and steals again.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个改过自新后又堕落、再次偷窃的贼。

entries.en: The mountain man guided the expedition across the frontier.
entries.zh: 那位山人带领探险队穿越边疆。

entries.en: Repairing every bridge before winter was a large order.
entries.zh: 入冬前修好所有桥梁是一项艰巨的任务。

entries.en: The shared driveway remained a bone of contention between the neighbors.
entries.zh: 共用车道一直是邻居之间的争议焦点。

entries.en: Please pass around the photographs without bending them.
entries.zh: 请把照片传给大家看，不要折弯。
